content.hebrew: אוֹמֵן אֱמֽוּנַת אֹֽמֶן בְּפִיו, בְּקוּמוֹ וּבְשִׁבְתּוֹ,
content.transliteration: Omen emunat omen befiv, beḳumo uvshivto,
content.english: The nurse had steadfast faithfulness in his mouth, when he arose and when he sat down,
content.comments:
The nurse. Moses.
Steadfast faithfulness. The Torah.

content.hebrew: בְּשָׁכְבוֹ וּבְלֶכְתּוֹ – בַּעֲלוֹתוֹ בְסִינַי וּבְרִדְתּוֹ.
content.transliteration: Beshokhvo uvlekhto – ba‘aloto veSinai uvridto.
content.english: And when he lay down and when he walked—in his ascent to Sinai, and in his descent.

content.hebrew: חֵֽשֶׁק יְדִידוּתָהּ בְּקִרְבּוֹ, וְלֶאֱכוֹל הִיא פִתּוֹ –
content.transliteration: Ḥesheḳ yedidutah beḳirbo, vele’ekhol hi fitto –
content.english: Inside him, he desired its belovedness, and it was his bread for eating—

content.hebrew: קהל: כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה בְאָמְנָה אִתּוֹ.  (אסתר ב:כ)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ka’asher hayeta ve’omna itto.
content.english: Cong. As it was when he was being brought up by it.   (Esth. 2:20)

content.hebrew: הֵא גְדוּדֵי רַעְיוֹנָיו תָּמִיד לְגַלּוֹת רְמִיזוֹת,
content.transliteration: Hē ḡedudē ra‘yonav tamid leḡallot remizot,
content.english: Behold, his legion thoughts would constantly reveal hints,

content.hebrew: כִּי שִׂכְלוֹ הוּכַן בְּפוּךְ הַמַּחֲזֶה, הוֹד לַחֲזוֹת.
content.transliteration: Ki sikhlo hukhan befukh hammaḥazē, hod laḥazot.
content.english: For his intelligence was prepared with the kohl of vision, to behold the splendor.

content.hebrew: עוֹד הוֹסִיף אִמְרֵי אֵל בְּפֶֽשֶׁר, כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת,
content.transliteration: ‘od hosif imrē El befesher, kazot vekhazot,
content.english: Moreover, he increased God’s words with explanation, thus and so—

content.hebrew: קהל: הוֹאִיל מֹשֶׁה בֵּאֵר אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת. (דברים א:ה)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ho’il Moshē be’er et hattora hazzot.
content.english: Cong. Moses began to elucidate this Torah.     (Deut. 1:5)

content.hebrew: רָדָה בְיַעֲרַת הַדְּבַשׁ, אִמְרֵי נֹֽעַם לְגַבֵּר,
content.transliteration: Rada veya‘arat haddevash, imrē no‘am leḡabber,
content.english: He scooped up the honeycomb, to enhance the sweet words,

content.hebrew: מִצְוֹת גְּלוּיוֹת עִם נִסְתָּרוֹת לְחַבֵּר.
content.transliteration: Mitsvot geluyot ‘im nistarot leḥabber.
content.english: To unite the revealed commandments with the concealed ones.

content.hebrew: וְעִמָּהֶן דִּבְרֵי תוֹכָחָה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּבֵּר:
content.transliteration: Ve‘immahen divrē tokhaḥa el benē Yisra’el dibber:
content.english: And along with [the commandments], he spoke words of rebuke to the Israelites:

content.hebrew: קהל: שִׁמְעוּ כִּי נְגִידִים אֲדַבֵּר.   (משלי ח:ו)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shim‘u ki neḡidim adabber.
content.english: Cong. “Listen, for I shall speak noble words.”    (Prov. 8:6)

content.hebrew: נְפָשׁוֹת הֶחֱיָה בְּלֶֽקַח טוֹב וְאוֹר עֵינַֽיִם,
content.transliteration: Nefashot heḥeya beleḳaḥ tov ve’or ‘enayim,
content.english: He brought life to souls, with good learning and light [for] the eyes;

content.hebrew: לְהַיְשִׁיר שִׁגְיוֹנֵי לֵב דִּבֶּר פַּעֲמַֽיִם.
content.transliteration: Lehayshir shiḡyonē lev dibber pa‘amayim.
content.english: To straighten the heart’s mistakes, he spoke twice.

content.hebrew: וּבְאֵזוֹר בִּינָה שִׁנֵּס מָתְנַֽיִם –
content.transliteration: Uv’ezor bina shinnes motnayim –
content.english: And with the belt of understanding, he girded his loins—

content.hebrew: קהל: מֵאֵת יוי מִן הַשָּׁמָֽיִם.   (בראשית יט:יד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Me’et Adonai min hash’shamayim.
content.english: Cong. From Adonai, from heaven.     (Gen. 19:14)

content.hebrew: הֶחֱלִיץ עַצְמוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּעוֹז הוֹדוֹ,
content.transliteration: Heḥelits ‘astmotenu be‘oz hodo,
content.english: [God] strengthened our bones, with the might of His splendor,

content.hebrew: בֶּאֱמוֹר כִּי יוי הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם לְבַדּוֹ.
content.transliteration: Be’emor ki Adonai hu hannilḥam lakhem levaddo,
content.english: When [Moses] said that Adonai was the One who alone fights for you.

content.hebrew: יְקַיֵּם אֹֽמֶר מַלְכּוֹ וּמַגִּידוֹ:
content.transliteration: Yeḳayyem omer malko umaggido:
content.english: May He fulfill the statement of His king, His spokesman:

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי בָנָה יוי צִיּוֹן, נִרְאָה בִּכְבוֹדוֹ. (תהלים קב:יז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki vana Adonai tsiyyon, nir’a bikhvodo.
content.english: Cong. For Adonai has built Zion; He has appeared in His Glory. (Ps. 102:17)

content.hebrew: [חזן: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יו֣י צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ: (תהלים קב:יז)]
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki vana Adonai tsiyyon, nir’a bikhvodo:
content.english: Cantor: For Adonai has built Zion; He has appeared in His Glory. (Ps. 102:17)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ: (יחזקאל ג:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barukh kevod Adonai mimmeḳomo:
content.english: Cong. Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
